The heart of every modern device are the electronics which manage the processes of the device and help the device to communicate with users. In order to manage all these functionalities, the overall development must be based on a thorough analysis and on explicit goals as to the purpose that must be achieved and the technology that must be used. Our vast knowledge of PCB design and basic electronics offer us an opportunity to design complex systems based on internationally approved components and on the software developed by us due to which the devices are able to accommodate the users with an extensive range of functionalities.

Globally, telecommunications companies must develop new ways of transmitting the data in the most efficient way. This progress has brought us to the point where we must study different protocols and communicate with different providers across the globe. Depending on the product and environment, we are able to choose the optimal communication protocol (LTE-M, NB IoT, Bluetooth, BLE, Wi-Fi etc.) and design the hardware and the software that is appropriated.
Company’s Vision: To become a leading development company in the field of sensor technology, for the general and the industrial environment.

entityDescription:
About Aerospace Propulsion Products B.V. (APP)
Aerospace Propulsion Products B.V. (APP) develops and manufactures advanced gas generator systems for a wide range of applications. Our gas generators produce either hot or cold gases and are used in demanding environments such as rocket engine ignition, turbo pump start systems, dust explosion suppression, parachute deployment systems, and medical oxygen generation.
Our History
APP was founded in 1985 by TNO, the Netherlands Organisation for Applied Scientific Research. Initially, the company focused entirely on the production of propellant for the igniters and starter systems of the Ariane 5 Vulcain rocket engine.
In 1995, Stork became a shareholder alongside TNO, enabling APP to expand its activities to the full production of Vulcain igniters and starter systems. Since then, APP has continuously broadened its expertise and product portfolio through the development and production of a wide variety of gas generator systems.
Today, APP is a wholly owned subsidiary of ArianeGroup SAS and continues to contribute to major European aerospace and industrial programs.
Our Products and Applications
APP has developed and produced systems for numerous high-profile programs and applications, including:
- Ignition systems for the Vinci upper-stage rocket engine

- Ignition systems for Prometheus and M10 rocket engines

- Igniters for the Vega launch vehicle first three stages (P80, Z23/Z40, and Z9)

- Fast gas generators for dust explosion suppression systems

- Parachute deployment devices for ExoMars and Space Rider missions

Our Organization
APP combines a straightforward and efficient organizational structure with highly specialized expertise. The company consists primarily of two core departments:
- Engineering

- Production

Today, APP employs around 45 highly skilled professionals, and we continue to grow as our activities expand.
Our Capabilities
APP offers complete in-house capabilities for:
- Technology development

- Engineering and design

- Qualification and testing

- Production and assembly

Our operations are performed according to the highest quality standards, including the stringent requirements applicable to the space industry. Safety is a key priority in both our product development and manufacturing processes, ensuring reliable and robust solutions for critical applications.
